reason: Harness 0.x: `ExaSearch`'s `num_results` is renamed to `max_results` and kept as a deprecated alias. The alias defaults to `None` in `from_spec` so that it can tell whether it was passed; the default of 5 moved to `max_results`. `ExaSearch(num_results=...)` still works and warns; read `max_results` instead of `num_results`.
